finding: Duplicate cases in NATQ-002 must be detected by shared GOLD EVIDENCE, not by question wording. A lexical screen is not sufficient and would have let a duplicate into the accepted 100.

lexical_screen.method: pairwise Jaccard over content tokens of question + intent, all 150 authored questions

the_case_it_missed.A09: does the model ever call two tools in one response
the_case_it_missed.A10: how do i turn off parallel tool calls
the_case_it_missed.lexical_similarity: below threshold — the two share almost no content vocabulary
the_case_it_missed.why_it_matters: Two accepted cases resolving to one span double that span's weight in every aggregate metric, and a system that happens to retrieve it well gets paid twice for one capability.

consequence_for_the_build: Evidence-collision detection cannot run before adjudication, because the gold span is the thing being compared and it does not exist until a case is adjudicated. Dedup is therefore a gate BETWEEN full adjudication and the selection of the accepted 100 — not a pre-screen.

rule_adopted.detect: after all 150 are adjudicated, group SUPPORTED cases by their gold span set; any group of size > 1 is an evidence collision
rule_adopted.adjudicate: each collision gets an explicit ruling — keep one, keep both because the reasoning types genuinely differ, or reject both
rule_adopted.do_not: do not resolve collisions by looking at how any retrieval system scores the cases
rule_adopted.record: every ruling is written down with its reason before the accepted 100 are frozen

collisions_found_so_far.ruling: DEFERRED to the post-adjudication dedup gate

note: Both A09 and A10 are individually valid and correctly adjudicated. They are recorded as PASS with the collision flagged. Nothing is deleted at this stage.
